name: tokei
description: Fast and accurate code statistics tool with support for 200+ programming languages

tools.description: Display statistics about code, including lines of code, comments, and blanks by language
tools.usage:
tokei . # Count lines in current directory
tokei --files src/ # Show per-file statistics
tokei --output json . # JSON format output
tokei --exclude '*.test.js' . # Exclude test files
tokei --sort lines . # Sort by line count
